response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced full-stack and systems engineer with strong C/C++ and Linux exposure, but his profile is almost entirely web, backend, and application-layer development rather than embedded networking security. He has no evident experience with Linux kernel source modification, MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, NETCONF/SNMP, or embedded firmware, and critically lacks native-level Japanese proficiency, which is a hard requirement for this role.
strengths: Solid multi-year software engineering track record with C/C++ experience (National Instruments, robotics work)
Strong Linux systems familiarity from DevOps and infrastructure work
Demonstrated ability to learn diverse tech stacks and work across the full stack
concerns: No native-level Japanese proficiency, which is a mandatory requirement
No demonstrated experience with Linux kernel internals, embedded firmware, or LAN-switch security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection)
Career trajectory is heavily web/backend/product focused, not embedded networking security

key_factors.factor: General C programming and Linux background
